name: Barley and Corn Casserole
description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder with bacon, potatoes, and a touch of milk.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups frozen or fresh corn kernels

recipeInstructions.text: Chop bacon and sauté in a large heavy pot with onions for 5 minutes.
Add celery and cook until onions are transparent.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes.
Gradually blend in hot stock, then add potatoes. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add corn and simmer for another 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Scald milk and add to soup for desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: corn chowder, creamy soup, bacon soup

_similar.name: Beef & Barley Soup
_similar.description: A hearty beef and barley soup with vegetables and tomato, ideal for freezing and reheating.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked roast beef (or 2-3 cups chopped hamburg meat)
½ cup pearl or pot barley

recipeInstructions.text: Heat water and bouillon cubes in a large pot, stirring until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients except beef and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1½ hours.
Add beef and simmer for an additional ½ hour.

_similar.name: Beef Birds in Wine
_similar.description: A hearty dish of beef cutlets rolled with a mixture of onions, mushrooms, and parsley, simmered in a rich wine and beef stock sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix onions, mushrooms, garlic, and parsley together.
Roll ¼ of the mixture up in each beef cutlet and secure with toothpicks.
Brown the rolls on all sides in olive oil. Remove rolls and keep warm.
Stir flour into pan drippings. Gradually add liquid and seasonings. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add meat rolls and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Add more liquid if needed.

_similar.keywords: beef birds, wine sauce, main dish
